problem.title: Local SEO services depend on signals that agree
problem.body: Local SEO services help people find accurate business information when they choose where to go or whom to contact. Inconsistent details, weak category context, and neglected profile signals make that decision harder to support.

method.title: Build local visibility from the Google Business Profile outward
method.intro: The focus stays on the business, its services, its customers, and the evidence that supports local relevance.

steps.title: Business facts
steps.body: Confirm the name, address, phone, hours, service details, and ownership information that customers and platforms should receive consistently.

steps.title: Google Business Profile relevance
steps.body: Review Google Business Profile categories, services, descriptions, photos, and updates against what the business actually offers and what local customers need to know.

steps.title: Trust signals
steps.body: Map reviews, responses, mentions, and local references into a process that supports accuracy without manufacturing endorsements or activity.

steps.title: Measure and maintain
steps.body: Set a practical review cadence for changes, questions, profile health, and local visibility so improvements do not depend on one launch.

outcome.title: A local presence customers can verify
outcome.body: The result is a maintainable local SEO process built around accurate information and useful customer signals, not a promise of a particular map position.
points: Consistent business facts across important profiles
Categories and services that reflect the real offer
A responsible workflow for reviews and profile updates
Checks that keep local information current

items.question: Can local SEO guarantee a map position?
items.answer: No. The work improves accuracy, relevance and maintenance around real business signals; it does not promise a particular position.

items.question: What information must be confirmed first?
items.answer: The business name, address, phone, hours, services, service area and ownership details need a reliable source before profiles are changed.

items.question: Do you create reviews?
items.answer: No. Review work covers a responsible request and response process. Endorsements, customer activity and local references are never manufactured.

items.question: How often should profiles be checked?
items.answer: Cadence depends on business changes and platform activity. The scope defines practical checks for facts, questions, reviews, updates and profile health.
